provenance.note: Fictional company written for harness validation. Not a real company; any resemblance is coincidental.

evidence.text: Haulsense Telematics provides fleet tracking and driver-safety analytics for regional trucking companies. Our in-cab gateway records driving events and uploads them to the Haulsense cloud dashboard over cellular networks.

The Haulsense Gateway is a compact in-cab device sold with a monthly per-vehicle subscription to the Haulsense dashboard. A dashcam add-on is available. Video analysis currently runs in our cloud after upload.
We are hiring an embedded engineer to explore running driver-distraction detection directly on the gateway to reduce cellular data costs.
